source: Make me an 3D game where you are black-white-brown Laika in a big realistic forest and you have hydration bar and hunger bar. you have to drink from lakes, rivers and ponds. And you have to hunt hares andsquirrels

image_prompt.text: Open buildable clearings in the forest where shelter could be raised
Lakes, rivers and ponds spread naturally through the forest with approachable open banks to drink from
Hares and squirrels visible in the underbrush and open meadows as huntable prey

layout_placement.text: Gatherable forest resources spread across the wooded biomes
Spawn origins and roaming ground for hares and squirrels near bushes and clearings

notes: Close call between Survival and Roleplay & Avatar Sim (animal sim); Survival chosen because hunger, hydration and hunting drive the loop.
No loaded option covers drinkable water bodies or non-hostile prey animals, so both are carried as free text.
Preset caveat: buildzone-plot is kept from the Resource Survival preset even though a dog protagonist has nothing to build with.

open_questions.ask: How big should the forest be - a few minutes of walking, or a full open world you can get lost in?
Is anything hunting the dog, or is survival purely about food and water?

coverage_missing.ask: How big should the forest be - a few minutes of walking, or a full open world you can get lost in?
Is anything hunting the dog, or is the player the only predator in the forest?
Is this single-player, or a multiplayer forest with other animals controlled by players?

answers.ask: How big should the forest be - a few minutes of walking, or a full open world you can get lost in?
answers.answer: Make it a few minutes of walking across, with a realistic forest, lakes, rivers, and ponds.

answers.ask: Is anything hunting the dog, or is survival purely about food and water?
answers.answer: Survival is purely about keeping the Laika fed and hydrated by hunting hares and squirrels and drinking water.
